mentions.name: TurboOps.io
mentions.description: TurboOps.io is a workflow engine whose first offering is a public job status tracker. It lets makers, small businesses and contractors create real-time status pages for their products and jobs to build customer trust and reduce inquiries. Email notifications are in development, with evidence support (tracking numbers, job pictures, contracts/documents) coming next.
mentions.problem: Businesses need a way to communicate job status to customers in real time to build trust and reduce customer inquiries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
TurboOps.io - a workflow engine for humans!

https://turboops.io/platform/public-tracker

Our first offering is a tracker for makers, small businesses and contractors to show job status. Create a real time status page for your products, build trust and reduce customer inquiries.
